notes: Item 19 is fully disclosed with three parts: Part A (417 Qualified Studios during Measurement Period Jan 1 - Dec 31, 2024) broken into gross revenue quartiles, monthly active members quartiles, and monthly new memberships quartiles; Part B (New Studios ramp data by month 1-12 for studios that soft-opened in calendar year 2024, n ranging from 69 in month 1 to 2 in month 12); and Part C (Average Revenue Mix percentages). All data is franchisee-level actuals. Gross Revenue excludes sales tax and Flexologist Training Program revenue. The quartile rankings in Parts A-1, A-2, and A-3 are each sorted independently by their respective metric, so the studios in each quartile differ across the three tables. Part B month 11 and 12 have very small sample sizes (n=3 and n=2) and should be interpreted with caution. One minor OCR artifact in Month 4 gross revenue row ('26 48%' missing slash) was interpreted as '26/48%'.
